description: This Java class defines configuration properties for Hono's tenant API, specifically related to file-based tenant registry configurations. It extends an abstract base class and provides a default filename for tenant data storage.

classes.name: FileBasedTenantsConfigProperties
classes.description: Represents configuration properties for file-based tenant registry, including a default file location.

methods.name: getDefaultFileName
methods.description: Returns the default file path for tenant configuration storage.
